title: Explicit native monoidal and coefficient-unit transport
statement: Given a NativeWeilTensorRingedBridge b [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-ringed-bridge], lift b.native to an equivalence of derived categories by applying the exact functors to complexes and localizing. For a ringed closed structure SB with symmetry betaB [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal], define nativeWeilRingedMonoidal to be Monoidal.transport along the inverse of that derived equivalence. Define nativeWeilRingedSymmetric by the symmetric-category transport instance. Given ringed tensor models TB and coherence cB, define nativeWeilRingedUnit by applying the inverse derived equivalence to cB.unitIso, then its single-functor factor, the inverse image of b.nativeUnit, and the original equivalence unit. These are explicit constructions, with no witness chosen from an unproved existence theorem.
